articles.title: Tech rout deepens globally; Softbank falls 15%, Nvidia down 4.5% premarket
articles.summary: Technology stocks tumbled globally on Wednesday, as renewed concerns over the artificial intelligence trade rattle investors and Monday's rally continues to fade. Japanese semiconductor stocks tied to the global AI supply chain were among the hardest hit. Technology-focused investor SoftBank Group shed 14.83%, while semiconductor inspection equipment maker Lasertec lost 11.23%.

articles.title: Treasury yields fall as investors await key inflation signal
articles.summary: Treasury yields edged lower Wednesday as investors looked ahead to fresh inflation and spending data in a holiday-shortened trading week. The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was 3 basis points lower at 4.8699%. The yield on the 2-year Treasury note, which typically moves in line with short-term Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, was down more than 4 basis points at 4.6291%.

articles.title: U.S. jury convicts Huawei in a criminal trial over fraud and trade secrets
articles.summary: Chinese technology giant Huawei was convicted Tuesday in New York on multiple federal criminal charges, including fraud, U.S. sanctions violations and conspiracy to steal trade secrets, following a three-month trial, according to the U.S. A federal jury found Huawei and three of its subsidiaries guilty of multiple offenses, including bank and wire fraud and conspiracy to commit money laundering, the Justice Department said in a statement.

articles.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price. Traders see even more pain
articles.summary: Anthropic shares are back trading below the IPO price after a 13% sell-off Tuesday and a 1.5% drop Monday, despite a broad rally in most big tech artificial intelligence names. Options volume on the stock is picking up as the shares drop and implied volatility jumps to 96, according to ThinkOrSwim data. Selling in-the-money puts in high-volatility stocks is often a way for traders to get long stock without the capital requirements of buying the underlying equity.

articles.title: Who qualifies for Costco’s $30-per-share dividend — plus, Meta puts share plan on hold
articles.summary: Tech stocks and the broader AI trade are facing a wave of selling, with Anthropic's drop below its $83 IPO price contributing to the negative sentiment. As the AI trade fell back, defensive sectors like healthcare and staples outperformed. The shares were intended to give Meta a way to fund its AI infrastructure buildout or make acquisitions without diluting CEO Mark Zuckerberg's voting power.

articles.title: Consumer confidence shoots up after Democrats' midterm victories — though inflation worries persist
articles.summary: Consumers grew significantly more optimistic in November in the wake of the midterm elections, with a growing number of Americans now seeing improvement in the labor market and expecting inflation to cool. While respondents "continued to express frustration with high prices and rising costs," they also "cited hope for the general economy," said Fergus McCormick, the board's senior economist for global indicators.
